title: Tentative agreement with outside workers' union approved
subtitle: Special meeting held mostly in closed session on labour relations; short open session ended with by-law and adjournment.
overview: Regional Council held a short special meeting on March 28, 2025. After going into closed session to consider labour relations related to a tentative agreement, Council returned to open session and approved a tentative Memorandum of Settlement for the Region's outside workers, who are represented by CUPE Local 1656 {{vote:m3}}.

The settlement covers January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2027. It sets the terms of employment for these workers for three years, which helps provide continuity for the services they deliver. The minutes do not report the details of the agreement, and the open session did not discuss them.

Council then passed the by-law confirming the meeting's proceedings and adjourned. The Regional Chair thanked councillors for their flexibility and thanked staff who worked on the matter under what was described as a very challenging set of circumstances.

decisions.detail: Council approved a tentative Memorandum of Settlement with CUPE Local 1656, which represents the Region's outside workers, covering January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2027 {{vote:m3}}.
